name: The Hu Music Pack
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

Mod adds in the Hu A Mongolian band you might know them from Star Wars Fallen Order or just in general etc. I only added their more well-known songs and some fan ones in.

Install instructions: Drag BepinEx Folder into SPT main Directory.

Enjoy!
